data_sources.name: Cabinet of Ministers resolution No. 578 (13.09.2025) on admission to higher education
data_sources.organization: Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan

requirements.label: SAT 1200+ → additional state grant
requirements.notes: SAT score of 1200 or higher (75% of the maximum): admission on an additional state grant to bachelor programmes whose entrance subjects match the certificate. Send the score electronically (College Board DI code). National rule (resolution No. 578).

requirements.label: IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL iBT 72 / Cambridge B2 → full English score
requirements.notes: IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72, Cambridge B2 First / C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency, or a national B2 certificate: the maximum score for the English entrance subject without sitting the exam. National rule (resolution No. 578).

requirements.label: A Level B+ / IB 32+ → contract place
requirements.notes: A Level grade B or higher, or International Baccalaureate 32 or higher: additional admission on the basic fee-contract to programmes whose entrance subjects match the certificate. National rule (resolution No. 578).
